== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Premiere-L-collision-PC-Errata-disc-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Collision! (PC Errata 2013 slip)]] (16 April 2013): Same words as the 2013 slip. This is a full card image: the printed art, lore and title, with the errata text in the game-text box. The last line breaks differently (“opponent must / lose one of them.” where the slip has “opponent must lose / one of them.”). There is no title strip and no “E”; a small round bronze disc sits at the lower right corner of the game-text box frame.

The 2013 slip and the same area of the disc image, scaled to the slip's width; nothing else is edited.
